children: Canada private equity manager reports Q2 net income, driven by higher portfolio valuation
Book value per share increased 2.1% qtr/qtr to C$101.35
Company completed two new investments and dissolved CEP III fund with top quartile returns
Clairvest expects to substantially complete the CEP VII investment program in 2027
Company says it has an active pipeline of investment opportunities under diligence
PORTFOLIO VALUATION GAINS - Co said net income was driven by a net increase in the valuation of its private equity investment portfolio
FUND COMPLETION - CEP III fund was dissolved after receiving remaining escrow proceeds, delivering a top quartile return for investors
NEW INVESTMENTS - Co and CEP VII completed two new investments in food and beverage and medical practice management sectors
